vectors.sourceSection: RFC 8785 Appendix B; Program Kit strict-subset rule
vectors.profileRule: Program Kit rejects negative zero rather than canonicalizing it to zero.

vectors.sourceSection: RFC 8785 Section 3.1; Program Kit strict-subset rule
vectors.profileRule: Program Kit canonical artifact strings must already be NFC and are never normalized by the canonicalizer.

vectors.sourceSection: RFC 8785 Appendix B note 1; Program Kit strict-subset rule
vectors.profileRule: Integer-valued numbers must remain in the interoperably exact range -9007199254740991 through 9007199254740991.

vectors.sourceSection: RFC 8785 Sections 3.1 and Appendix D; Program Kit strict-subset rule
vectors.profileRule: Numbers requiring greater precision than IEEE 754 binary64 must be modeled as schema-constrained strings.

vectors.sourceSection: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.4; Program Kit strict-subset rule
vectors.profileRule: Program Kit canonical input and output use UTF-8 without a BOM.
